description: Language-neutral conformance suite for the Capsule integrity hash (spec 9.1.1). Every implementation in every language MUST pass every vector before claiming conformance. This file exists because publishing a test vector inside prose was not enough: a consuming implementation shipped without pinning it and filed a false 'tampered' verdict (F44).
how_to_use: Parse manifest_json and data_json with YOUR parser - the point is to exercise your parser, not this file's convenience.
Canonicalize each with the recipe named in the vector; compare against canonical_manifest / canonical_data. This checkpoint isolates canonicalization from hashing.
Join with a single LF (0x0A) to form canonical_payload, encode UTF-8, SHA-256, prefix 'sha256:'; compare against expected_hash.
Run the unit_tests batteries too - they isolate number, string, and key-order behaviour so a failure points at its cause.

v1-legacy.canonical_form: Sorted keys, no whitespace, non-ASCII unescaped, numbers formatted as Python 3 repr() (integer-valued floats keep '.0'; exponent notation below 1e-4 and at/above 1e16; two-digit zero-padded exponents).
v1-legacy.note: Never applied to a capsule declaring spec_version 0.4.0 or later.

constraints: Object keys sort by UTF-16 code units as unsigned integers (NOT code point order - supplementary-plane characters sort before U+FFFF).
Strings escape only the five JSON shorthands, remaining C0 controls as lowercase backslash-uhhhh, quote and backslash. U+2028/U+2029 are NOT escaped.
Integers MUST satisfy |n| <= 2**53 (exactly representable as IEEE 754 doubles); implementations MUST error rather than round.
The int/float distinction is erased by design: 55.0 and 55 canonicalize identically.

steps: Copy the manifest; set integrity.content_hash to the literal 'sha256:pending'; keep the real hash_scope.
payload_assembly.note: hash_scope 'data_only' hashes canonical(data) alone; 'full_document' is byte-based and unaffected by either recipe.

jcs_strings.note: five shorthands stay shorthand; other C0 controls become lowercase backslash-uhhhh
line/paragraph separators are NOT escaped (some JS serializers escape them; RFC 8785 does not)
DEL is not a C0 control; not escaped

jcs_key_order.note: THE discriminating case: UTF-16 order puts the emoji before U+FFFF; code-point order would not.
sorting is recursive; array order is preserved

jcs_must_error.note: A parser that silently rounds to a double will not see this; implementations SHOULD inspect the source token.
Input must be valid Unicode; a lone surrogate cannot be encoded as UTF-8.
